column4: Pondo sa Pagbabago at Pag-asenso (P3) Program
column6: The P3 Program is a microenterprise financing program designed to lend out accessible and affordable loans up to 30.0% per annum.  In line with the government's poverty alleviation efforts, SBCorp launched the P3 Program in 2017 to provide affordable microfinancing to businessowners. The P3 provides micro loans of up to PhP300.0 thousand with monthly interest ranging from 1.0% to 2.5%.
